question:
The year - wise student enrollment of two schools over a period of 5 years has been presented in the following bar graph. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4bdc0ce1cd6c61d0043710f6a42f99eb5e634521d1934b5b22e36609f1f5eeb.png] 

In which year is the difference of enrollment in the two schools, the least?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The difference of enrollment in the two schools in 2015 = (532 – 515) = 17

The difference of enrollment in the two schools in 2016 = (540 – 465) = 75

The difference of enrollment in the two schools in 2017 = (550 – 490) = 60

The difference of enrollment in the two schools in 2018 = (570 – 540) = 30

The difference of enrollment in the two schools in 2019 = (750 – 600) = 150

**∴ The difference of enrollment in the two schools, the least in 2015**
